Example: number '784-1990-1

tools.name: detect_identifier
tools.description: Try every validator for the given country plus the international ones and return the types that accept the value, best first (checksum-bearing types rank above pattern-only ones). Use when a document or form field holds a number of unknown type. A match is structural, not proof of type. Example: num
